message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to VirusTotal’s live data, so I can’t provide the actual CNAME record IDs for `sample.com`. To obtain them yourself, you can call the following endpoint with your API key:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records
Authorization: Bearer secret123
```

The JSON response will contain an array of DNS record objects, each with an `id` field that holds the record’s unique identifier. Those `id` values are the “related object IDs” you’re looking for.
